findings.highlight: she always screws up at the crucial moment
findings.governingReading: she fails when it matters most
findings.explanation: Rin’s specific tendency at decisive moments is broadened with unsupported “always.”

findings.highlight: I let my luck take over
findings.evidenceJa: 有るか無いかの偶然に期待して
findings.governingReading: hoping for the bare chance that she might be there
findings.explanation: A desperate reliance on a slim chance becomes the odd claim that luck takes control.

findings.highlight: there’s no need to attack me
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっかい出す必要もない
findings.governingReading: there is no need even to meddle with me
findings.explanation: Other Masters’ lack of interest is narrowed to literal attack.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は俺に尻尾を見せるほど甘くない
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is not soft enough to show me her tail
findings.explanation: The predatory pursuit image and Rin’s canny agency are flattened into absence of evidence.

findings.highlight: I won’t let that happen so easily
findings.evidenceJa: そう簡単にいくもんか
findings.governingReading: things cannot go that badly so easily
findings.explanation: Shirou’s denial of likelihood becomes a claim that he can prevent the outcome.

findings.highlight: This is a certain knowledge, like a conviction
findings.evidenceJa: 確信に近いイメージだった
findings.governingReading: it was an image close to conviction
findings.explanation: A sensation approaching certainty is promoted into certain knowledge.
